content:
The International Journal of Language and Communication Disorders (IJLCD) is a peer-reviewed academic journal that covers research in the field of communication disorders, specifically focusing on speech, language, and hearing disorders. The journal publishes original research articles, reviews, and clinical forum papers that address a wide range of topics related to language and communication disorders.

IJLCD is published by Wiley on behalf of the Royal College of Speech and Language Therapists (RCSLT) in the United Kingdom. The journal was first launched in 1966 and has since become a leading publication in the field of communication disorders, attracting submissions from researchers, clinicians, and educators from around the world.

The journal aims to provide a platform for the dissemination of high-quality research that advances understanding and knowledge in the field of communication disorders. It covers a broad range of topics, including language development, speech production, auditory processing, language impairments, and communication interventions.

IJLCD is indexed in major academic databases such as PubMed, Medline, Scopus, and Web of Science, which ensures that the research published in the journal reaches a wide audience of researchers and practitioners in the field of communication disorders.

Overall, the International Journal of Language and Communication Disorders is a valuable resource for researchers, clinicians, and educators interested in the latest developments in the field of communication disorders.
